decisions.title: Announcement create
decisions.established_gap: No conventional write API found, but B2 traces the existing native announcement creation form/handler.
decisions.alternatives: Implement/test native HTTP flow; do not assume catalog loss or upgrade required.
decisions.required_gate: Delegated flow, formatting/notifications/author/channel and synthetic reconciliation acceptance.

historical_api_only_finding.established_gap: No existing write interface in inspected baseline; current default write is custom
historical_api_only_finding.alternatives: Select a separately researched baseline/version with a genuine existing API; explicitly accept unavailable default write/catalog change; or defer that migration portion. Human native UI may be a disclosed manual handoff, not MCP automation parity.
historical_api_only_finding.required_gate: Before removing default create dependency or claiming all five capabilities preserved. No new native endpoint/controller.

decisions.title: Controlled setup/publish
decisions.established_gap: B3-B6 native draft/save/edit/post, linked calendar and Gradebook configuration paths found; SOAP-only incompatibility is not a missing UI operation.
decisions.alternatives: Implement existing native HTTP flow and verify per-field semantics, staging/defaults/attachments/time precision.
decisions.required_gate: Per-field setup and partial-outcome acceptance before cutover; native-first guarantee differences documented.

historical_api_only_finding.established_gap: A8 immediately posted create with unavoidable/different Gradebook/calendar/release semantics; no equivalent publish/update action found
historical_api_only_finding.alternatives: Explicitly adopt/version a restricted actual-SOAP contract if useful and safe; retain full requirement and investigate upstream/version option; or acknowledge setup automation unsupported while manual native workflow continues.
historical_api_only_finding.required_gate: Before any setup routing switch/retirement. Must enumerate every lost policy and migrate existing drafts/partial setups.

decisions.title: Concurrency, save side effects and verification
decisions.established_gap: Assignment writes lack old custom CAS; Gradebook UI has native old-grade checks. Save/retract/return differ; independent Gradebook read candidates now exist.
decisions.alternatives: Use ordinary native behavior with explicit observation/recovery guarantees; preserve exact write semantics and disclose extra custom guarantee changes.
decisions.required_gate: Field preservation, selected score/state readback, concurrency/uncertain-response tests and reviewed public guarantee wording.

historical_api_only_finding.established_gap: A7 lacks client CAS/native idempotency; may clear side fields/write blank projections; independent Gradebook score readback absent
historical_api_only_finding.alternatives: Accept tested best-effort observed writes with strict guard/journal/manual reconciliation and explicitly changed guarantee; require stronger guarantees and leave commit unavailable; evaluate independently existing future/version API separately.
historical_api_only_finding.required_gate: Before enabling existing-API commit; no Python lock marketed as native serialization.

decisions.title: Public schema/coverage
decisions.established_gap: UI pages expose additional points/settings/scores/release flags; native item identity, TA scope, precision, active mode and historical completeness need fixtures.
decisions.alternatives: Exhaust safe B3/B6/B7 candidates before deciding unavailable fields or schema loss.
decisions.required_gate: Per-tool/field/role evidence and honest versioned observations; no fabricated values.

historical_api_only_finding.established_gap: Primary DTO gaps in config/release/version/maximum/settings/orphan/roster; A14 raw-object possibility unverified and A4 list over-fetches evidence; grader aggregates cannot satisfy own/selected grade semantics
historical_api_only_finding.alternatives: First test safe A14 coverage and the lean SOAP metadata alternative; then preserve exact schema with explicit unsupported operations, or review v3 coverage/unknown fields and documented default own-grade/data-minimization limits.
historical_api_only_finding.required_gate: Before public compatibility fixtures/skills cutover. Exhaust the stated safe existing candidates before accepting loss; no fabricated false/zero/complete.

decisions.title: Auth mechanism
decisions.established_gap: Entra/OBO retained; browser forms/Wicket require bounded same-actor native session continuity and real cross-WAR placement dispatch.
decisions.alternatives: Auth-only private flow nonce/session candidate in section 16.6; no new endpoints/password/admin fallback.
decisions.required_gate: Actual existing-handler container tests, ordinary-login regression and per-flow cleanup/isolation before deployment.

historical_api_only_finding.established_gap: Recommended OBO/session integration is source-supported design, not deployed across contexts. Native OAuth1 is different consent/credential model
historical_api_only_finding.alternatives: Keep intended OBO with auth-only per-context extension (recommended); explicitly choose a different user-consented credential UX with separate evidence.
historical_api_only_finding.required_gate: Local design approval; native deployment separately authorized. No admin/password shortcut.

decisions.title: Store/retention/legacy ownership
decisions.established_gap: Native private files/UID-only keys/24h captures and persistent sensitive receipts; current MCP lacks declared external durable store
decisions.alternatives: Private managed-identity Blob design; another approved conditional durable backend; import active records or allow short-lived records to expire with preserved receipts/archive
decisions.required_gate: Before provisioning/import/cutover. Set receipt/backups retention and verified owner mapping; no automatic deletion/expiry reset.

decisions.title: Ordinary UI/security retirement
decisions.established_gap: Current AssignmentAction depends on custom hydration helper; draft access guard corrects baseline behavior; restoring vanilla can reintroduce bugs
decisions.alternatives: Establish that removing MCP changes restores safe ordinary behavior with regression proof; select an independently reviewed upstream fix/version; otherwise keep native retirement gate open
decisions.required_gate: Before deleting helper/security hunks or declaring unextended native business completion. Separate defect work, not a new MCP business extension.

decisions.alternatives: Prepare exact revisions/read-only probes and request explicit start/deploy/activation/fixture/academic-write authority in the future relevant phase
decisions.required_gate: No runtime action in this planning session. Source findings remain valid with FV live gates open.
